entries.name: SiriUserSegments
entries.note: private framework, owner Intents; from SDK matrix siri-kit.json
entries.ready_note: Apps declare [[intent]] tables in manifest.toml and serve them on their control socket. Search and the Shortcuts action library list and run an installed app's shortcut intents (shell::intents::runnable_shortcuts). The assistant answers with intent cards that run only after the user confirms them, and reads answers aloud when Speak Answers is on. Voice recognition is not built: nothing turns speech into an intent request, so Siri's spoken requests are not covered.

entries.name: Skimmer
entries.note: n/a: Siri intelligence-flow component. The reference index shows a bare framework (Info.plist and version.plist); its only other mention is WorkflowResponsiveness/Resources/WorkflowPlists/SiriIntelligenceFlow_CustomInterval_SkimmerDecision.plist, a Siri flow responsiveness workflow. BifrOSt does not mirror Siri flows.

entries.name: SkyLight
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: bifrost-wm is the window server and the only compositor (docs/window-server.md); the private SkyLight API itself is not mirrored.

entries.name: Sleep
entries.note: n/a: Health sleep tracking and sleep schedules (Apple Watch and iPhone sleep data, Sleep Focus). The reference index shows a localized-only resource bundle (about 40 languages, no code resources); the only other mention is the Siri AlarmFlowPlugin template SleepAlarmDescriptionModifier. BifrOSt has no Health data store and no sleep-tracking hardware to mirror.

entries.name: SleepHealthUI
entries.note: private framework, owner n/a: HealthKit data is not mirrored

entries.name: Slideshows
entries.note: Keynote and Photos slideshow effect content (mrbEffect bundles, OpusKit); Apple app content with no BifrOSt job.

entries.name: SmartNameSuggestions
entries.note: Apple ML name suggestions XPC service for Mail and Contacts; Apple-service suggestion model.

entries.name: SmartReplies
entries.note: Apple ML smart-reply runtime plug-in and reply stop-word and factor assets for Messages and Mail.

entries.name: SmartRepliesServer
entries.note: Server side of Apple smart replies (Messages ML); no BifrOSt counterpart.

entries.name: SmartRepliesUI
entries.note: UI of Apple smart replies (Messages and Mail); no BifrOSt counterpart.

entries.name: SnippetCommands
entries.note: Apple Siri and Spotlight snippet commands; Apple assistant service.

entries.name: SnippetKit
entries.note: Apple Siri and Spotlight snippet model; Apple assistant service.

entries.name: SnippetUI
entries.note: Apple Siri and Spotlight snippet UI; Apple assistant service.

entries.name: SnippetUI_Proto
entries.note: Protocol bundle for Apple Siri snippet UI; Apple assistant service.

entries.name: SocialAppsCore
entries.note: Social account core: the account store (service, user name, signing method), credentials in the keychain, web sign-in sessions and OAuth credentials.
entries.ready_note: Accounts are metadata plus secrets kept in the keychain (social_account.rs); sign-in runs as a web session that ends on the app callback scheme (sign_in.rs); OAuth credentials are typed (oauth_credential.rs). No social network service ships, by design (privacy-first: BifrOSt bundles no third-party network clients); an app that adds a service signs in through these and sends requests signed by the account. Host tests only.

entries.name: SocialLayer
entries.note: n/a: sociallayerd is Apple's social account broker for the account types BifrOSt does not carry. BifrOSt keeps no third-party social accounts and makes no third-party lookups (privacy-first, lead decision). Previous note: private framework, owner Social; from SDK matrix social.json

entries.name: SocialServices
entries.note: Social services: service request assembly (GET, POST, multipart), OAuth 1.0a and OAuth 2 signing, bearer tokens and refresh.
entries.ready_note: social.rs builds the HTTP request for a web service, social_account.rs signs it with the account, social_oauth2.rs reads token responses, signs as a bearer and builds the refresh POST. No named networks (privacy-first). Host tests only.

entries.name: SocialUI
entries.note: Social UI: the share menu (installed apps and Copy) and the Compose Post sheet with typed text, attachments, links and a character count.
entries.ready_note: The share menu lists the installed apps that accept the items plus Copy; Compose Post opens a sheet seeded from the shared items, editable by typing. Post hands text, attachments and links to the clipboard because no network service sits behind it. The share sheet has no image property (images are shared as file items). Host tests only; not verified on Midget.

entries.name: SoftLinking
entries.note: Apple runtime soft-linking helper for private frameworks; no BifrOSt job.

entries.name: SoftwareUpdate
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: softwareupdate CLI (springboard/cmd/src/softwareupdate.rs) talks to the update agent (springboard/updated); the Settings page and background schedule are in shell/ota.rs.

entries.name: SoftwareUpdateCore
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: Update check, schedule and notices are in springboard/src/shell/ota.rs, with the update agent springboard/updated doing the install work.

entries.name: SoftwareUpdateCoreConnect
entries.note: Apple software update catalogue connection; BifrOSt updates come from its own release channel (see SoftwareUpdateCore, updated).

entries.name: SoftwareUpdateCoreSupport
entries.note: Apple software update support files (framework sandbox profile); BifrOSt updates come from its own release channel.

entries.name: SoftwareUpdateMacController
entries.note: Apple software update Mac controller UI; BifrOSt Software Update is its own shell page on the updated daemon.

entries.name: SonicAudioUnits
entries.note: The mixer parameters of a transition (two gains, a low cut on each song, incoming playback rate) as automation over the overlap. Lead 2026-10-17: not ready: the audio service has no crossfade command, so nothing plays the automix plan.

entries.name: SonicFoundation
entries.note: Shared foundations of the transition engine: beat grids (RhythmResult), tempo folding for half and double time, bar arithmetic. Lead 2026-10-17: not ready: the audio service has no crossfade command, so nothing plays the automix plan.

entries.name: SonicKit
entries.note: Beat-matched transitions between songs (automix): the plan comes from ui::automix over the song beat grids. Lead 2026-10-17: not ready: the audio service has no crossfade command, so nothing plays the automix plan.

entries.name: SpaceAttribution
entries.note: Space attribution: the data partition is accounted by category and by per-app container, shown as the Storage usage bar.
entries.ready_note: Index: spaceattributiond plus CacheDelete_PathList.plist and SpaceAttributionFramework_PathList.plist (which paths count towards which category and are purgeable). Storage::Scanner classifies the data partition by category in a worker thread (Usage, account, bar_widths) and the Storage page draws it; per-app containers split Documents, Library and purgeable Caches (container_layout.rs). Host tests only.

entries.name: SpanMatcher
entries.note: n/a: no BifrOSt-visible function found, and no evidence that one exists. The reference index shows a bare framework (Info.plist, version link; no resources, plug-ins, XPC services or hosting bundle; no other bundle names it). It is an Apple-internal span-matching helper of the Siri and language-understanding stack, which BifrOSt does not mirror. Lead to confirm.

entries.name: Spark
entries.note: n/a: no BifrOSt-visible function found, and no evidence that one exists. The reference index shows a bare framework (Info.plist and version.plist; no resources, plug-ins, XPC services or hosting bundle; the only other Spark-named hit is the unrelated Messages Sparkles effect). Treated as an Apple-internal component with nothing to mirror. Lead to confirm.

entries.name: SpatialPreviewUI
entries.note: private framework, owner SpatialPreview; from SDK matrix spatial-preview.json

entries.name: SpatialProxy
entries.note: n/a: visionOS spatial computing, no such hardware on BifrOSt

entries.name: SpeakerRecognition
entries.note: Apple Siri speaker-recognition model pack (factors, pitch extractor); Apple ML asset.

entries.name: SpectroKit
entries.note: n/a: instrument-based display calibration data. The reference index shows a CIE 1931 colour matching table (CIEXYZ1931_2deg.json) and per-backlight spectral correction files (calibrations/*.edr, custom/) for the Display Calibrator Assistant's spectrophotometer and colorimeter support of Apple panels. It needs Apple panel calibration data and USB instruments; BifrOSt colour management (ICC profiles, EDID primaries) is render/src/icc.rs and sdk colorsync.rs.

entries.name: SpeechDetector
entries.note: Speech detection: voice activity detection over audio (speech spans, next speech time, skip silence).
entries.ready_note: voice_activity.rs finds speech spans; Voice Memos uses it to skip silence. Host tests only.

entries.name: SpeechDictionary
entries.note: n/a: Apple's speech dictionary data packs (the lexicon data behind Apple's recognizer). BifrOSt's recognizer is its own Whisper backend (springboard/sdk/src/speech_recognizer.rs) and ships no Apple model or lexicon packs. Previous note: private framework, owner Speech; from SDK matrix speech.json

entries.name: SpeechEngine
entries.note: The speech engines: on-device recognition through the whisper pipeline (shell recognizer service, SDK backend) and text to speech through espeak.
entries.ready_note: Recognition: pipeline argv and transcript parser (whisper.rs), the shell recognizer service, and the SDK WhisperBackend behind the recognizer API. Synthesis: speech_engine.rs drives espeak-ng. Needs the model, which the person downloads after consent. Host tests only; not verified on Midget. No SpeechAnalyzer-shaped engine surface beyond the recognizer API.

entries.name: SpeechObjects
entries.note: Speech result objects: transcription with segments (timestamp, duration, confidence), partial and final results, contextual strings.
entries.ready_note: speech_recognizer.rs has the request, task, result, transcription and segment types; recognition.rs the ranged results and contextual strings. No alternative transcriptions beyond the best one. Host tests only.

entries.name: SpeechRecognitionCommandServices
entries.note: Dictation commands: spoken punctuation, new line and paragraph, case, no space, literal and "scratch that", in English and Icelandic.
entries.ready_note: Built in wave 12: Interpreter turns recognized phrases into text edits (backspaces plus insert); the on-screen keyboard types dictation through it and Dictation::with_commands offers it to controls. Spoken commands that drive the UI ("click", "open") are not covered. Host tests only; not verified on Midget.

entries.name: SpeechRecognitionCore
entries.note: private framework, owner Speech; from SDK matrix speech.json
entries.ready_note: On-device recognition: the whisper pipeline, the consent gate, the shell recognizer service and the SDK client are covered by unit tests. It needs the model download (Settings, Keyboard, Dictation, after consent) and a run on Midget; the pipeline transcript format is checked there.

entries.name: SpeechRecognitionSharedSupport
entries.note: Shared recognition support: the on-device model install and the shell recognizer service the apps share.
entries.ready_note: speech_assets.rs models the consented model download and install; the recognizer service is the one process that runs recognition for every app. Host tests only; the install path is not verified on Midget.

entries.name: SpeechRuntime
entries.note: The speech runtime: the shell-hosted recognizer service apps drive through the SDK, with microphone consent and analyzer input conversion.
entries.ready_note: The shell owns the microphone and runs the pipeline (start, poll, stop); apps ask through speech_whisper and the SDK privacy_permissions request. The audio service records only on explicit user action, so an app cannot stream raw microphone audio to its own recognizer; that is a deliberate privacy limit. Host tests only; not verified on Midget.

entries.name: SpeechTranslation
entries.note: n/a: Apple's on-device translation model packs and translation service. An ML model pack, and BifrOSt ships no Apple model packs. Previous note: private framework, owner Speech; from SDK matrix speech.json

entries.name: SportsKit
entries.note: n/a: Apple Sports service data and feed, not mirrored

entries.name: StorageContainersPrivate
entries.note: Storage containers: the fixed per-app container layout (Documents, Library, Library/Caches, tmp) and which parts the system may purge.
entries.ready_note: container_layout.rs defines the folders, refuses symbolic-link container roots and marks Caches and tmp purgeable; cache_purge.rs plans the least-recently-used purge when space runs short. The reference index lists no files for this framework, so this is the name-based reading. Host tests only.

entries.name: StorageManagementService
entries.note: Storage management service: low-space guard that clears caches by itself, the Storage clean-up actions and the "empty the Trash after 30 days" policy.
entries.ready_note: Index: StorageManagement.framework/PlugIns/StorageManagementService and its man page. storage.rs has the Guard (clears disposable caches when /data runs low), CLEARS actions and purge_app_caches over idle apps; the 30-day Trash policy is written by privd (storage.policy_set) and executed by files/trash.rs. Host tests only.

entries.name: SwiftASN1
entries.note: ASN.1 DER codec: strict reader and writer for tags, lengths, integers, booleans, bit strings, strings, times and object identifiers.
entries.ready_note: Built in wave 12: bifrost_core::der (strict DER, bounded nesting) with bifrost_core::oid for identifiers. Host tests only.

entries.name: SwiftASN1Internal
entries.note: Internal helpers of the DER codec: header and length coding, canonical-form checks, time conversion.
entries.ready_note: Internal plumbing of the DER codec implemented in one module (der.rs parse_header, push_length, time helpers), covered by its tests.

entries.name: SwiftCRLite
entries.note: Offline certificate revocation by filter cascade: build, encode, decode and look up. Lead 2026-10-17: not ready: no filter cascade ships and the TLS path does not consult it.

entries.name: SwiftCertificate
entries.note: X.509 certificates: parse and assemble, names, validity, basic constraints, key usage, alternative names, chain evaluation and the trust panels.
entries.ready_note: Built in wave 12: bifrost_core::x509 parses certificate DER into fields and feeds bifrost_app::trust (Certificate::from_x509); the certificate panel and trust editor models exist. Signature verification is left to rustls; no OCSP or policy trees. Host tests only.

entries.name: SwiftMLS
entries.note: n/a: Message Layer Security client of iMessage group chats. The reference index shows SwiftMLS.plist (feature flag), the com.apple.SwiftMLS logging subsystem plist, and a copy inside DiagnosticExtensions.framework/PlugIns/IMDiagnosticExtension.appex, all iMessage. iMessage is an Apple-only protocol with no open equivalent; BifrOSt messaging uses Matrix.

entries.name: SwiftMedia
entries.note: Media playback views and controls: player view chrome and layout, playback speed steps and subtitle selection.
entries.ready_note: player_view.rs models the video player view and its controls; speed.rs and subtitles.rs are the speed and subtitle pickers' models. The route, speed and subtitle picker views are not all drawn yet (tracked on _SwiftMedia_SwiftUI). Host tests only.

entries.name: SwiftSQLite

entries.name: SwiftTLS
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: TLS client transport (rustls, graviola) for the shell and apps is covered by sdk tls_client host tests. The reference Swift TLS stack itself is not reimplemented.

entries.name: SwiftUIAccessibility
entries.note: Accessibility for declarative views: element map, roles, actions, announcements (Ctx::announce, politeness priorities), display flags and the AT-SPI bridge.
entries.ready_note: ax.rs has the element map, role names, custom actions and the announcement queue; Ctx::announce is the app-facing live-region call; accessible_look.rs and accessibility_display.rs carry the display settings. Untested on a live Orca session; the declarative accessibility modifiers are part of the view layer, not this row. Host tests only.

entries.name: SymptomLinkAdvisory
entries.note: Link advice for apps: path status, interface kinds and the expensive (metered) flag that tells an app to hold back traffic.
entries.ready_note: net_path.rs derives the path (satisfied or not, interfaces in preference order, expensive when the primary link is metered) from the network daemon's reports; apps read it through network_path.rs and reachability flags. No congestion or low-quality advisory beyond status and metered; the reference index lists only the framework stub. Host tests only.

entries.name: SymptomNetworkDiagnostics
entries.note: Network diagnosis: explains the first failing stage of a request (link, address, name lookup, connection, handshake, status) with the next step for the person.
entries.ready_note: net_diagnostic.rs takes the observations the app or shell records and returns the first failure with a title and next step; link_conditioner.rs shapes test links. The framework's Common and Core companions (SymptomNetworkDiagnosticsCommon, SymptomNetworkDiagnosticsCore) are listed as separate frameworks. Diagnostics stay local; nothing is uploaded. Host tests only.
